messages:
alex: Heads up — we're seeing noisy failures from the notify-gateway (internal name: notify-proxy) and incident-bot isn't creating pages when severity is >= P1. Customers reporting delayed notifications.

sophia: Confirmed. Error spike started ~1712299900, routing header `X-Incident-Severity` appears missing in the webhook payload. incident-bot logs show 'unmapped_severity' warnings.

incident-bot: [automated] Received webhook id=wh_9a2f, severity=unknown — routing skipped (reason=missing_severity_tag).

devon: Quick check: we just rolled signing proxy rev 2.14 -> 2.15 at 1712299800 to tighten header validation. Suspect drop there.

alex: Can someone post the recent webhook payload example?

devon: Paste of failing payload (redacted):

```
{
  "id": "wh_9a2f",
  "source": "notify-proxy",
  "headers": {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "X-Signature": "sha256=..."
    // NOTE: X-Incident-Severity header missing
  },
  "body": { "event": "alert", "meta": { "service": "embed-api" } }
}
```

oncall-mike: I just got pinged by CS — some customers saw mobile push delays and 502s for /v1/embeddings. Are we sure this is only routing?

lisa-cs: We have two customers (acme-co, betaapp) who reported "notifications not received" and increased 5xx rate from 10:45-10:50 UTC. Impact: delayed alerts and missed pages.

alex: Triage actions: 1) revert header validation change on signing proxy to 2.14, 2) enable manual fallback paging in incident-bot until fix, 3) notify impacted customers. Can we get a volunteer for deploy rollback?

sophia: I'm on rollback. Patch to revert in k8s: `kubectl set image deploy/signing-proxy signing-proxy=signing-proxy:2.14` — applying now.

devon: Reverting now, rolling update started. Also enabling verbose incident-bot logging: CONFIG=incident.logging=debug — restarting helm release.

incident-bot: [automated] Detected config change, enabling fallback rule: if severity missing then route to oncall channel `#oncall-pager` as untriaged.

alex: Good. mike, start manual paging for the two customers while we verify. Follow runbook step 3 (manual page + annotate incidents).

oncall-mike: Manual pages sent at 1712300060 to both oncall sequences. Confirmed ack from oncall.

lisa-cs: Customer updates sent — apologizing and noting active mitigation. They've asked for incident timeline when resolved.

sophia: Revert finished at 1712300105, signing-proxy back to 2.14. Error rate dropping, incident-bot started auto-routing again.

incident-bot: [automated] Webhook id=wh_9a2f reprocessed, severity=P1 detected, routed to `#incidents` and paged oncall.

devon: Post-rollback check: run query for missing severity headers in last 15m: `SELECT count(*) FROM webhooks WHERE headers->>'X-Incident-Severity' IS NULL AND ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'`. Count=12. Looks like a windowed drop during the deploy.

alex: Root cause (prelim): signing-proxy change made header canonicalization stricter and dropped nonconforming headers. That broke severity tag for a subset of internal webhooks -> incident-bot skipped pages.

lisa-cs: Customer impact summary for postmortem: - Customers affected: acme-co, betaapp (support tickets), some internal alerting missed immediate paging. - User-visible: delayed notifications, short 502 spike on embeddings endpoint. - Mitigation: rollback, manual paging, customer comms.

devon: Next steps: 1) create hotfix to preserve headers even if validation fails (soft-fail mode) 2) add unit/integration test for X-Incident-Severity presence 3) add metric/alert when incident-bot routes are skipped (counter on 'skipped_due_to_severity_missing') 4) runbook update to include manual paging guide.

alex: I'll open the postmortem and assign owners. Thanks all for fast rollback and manual paging. Please add any missed details to the thread. :thumbsup:

lisa-cs: Adding support ticket IDs to postmortem: #SUP-4312, #SUP-4319.

oncall-mike: All systems normal at 1712300180. Closing active manual pages.
